sources_tried: Seed file des-moines.json: worked, but almost every result was a residential bath remodeler, store or plumber. Plausible leads were J. Laurenzo (Urbandale), Doors Inc and Premier Construction.
Bobrick find-a-rep (bobrick.com/find-a-rep): page loaded, but the results come from a JavaScript dropdown, so no reps were readable.
Scranton Products find-a-distributor: 404. A Scranton case study (Cedar Rapids) named no dealer or installer.
ASI, Bradley, Metpar, General Partitions, Ampco locators: not reached before the budget ran out.
The Blue Book (thebluebook.com search and iProView pages): 403 blocked.
BuildingConnected / Procore public profiles: not reached (no results surfaced in search).

WebSearch, 8 calls (the cap): mostly specs, bid documents and national online sellers (One Point Partitions, Partition Pros, Prestige, GCS, CSI). National sellers were skipped as having no local base. Found Walsh Door (Des Moines) and confirmed J. Laurenzo.

City of Des Moines bid tabulation (Forest Avenue Library restroom, 2025): it read fine but lists only general contractors (Weston Companies, DSM Property Services, BallTeam, GTG, Bergstrom, Neumann Brothers, Trinity, Giardino, Ferris), not partition subcontractors, so none were included.
Existing repo research batch-6.json (Omaha): gave EPCO (Council Bluffs) and Ruck Specialties (Omaha) as regional leads.

candidates.name: J. Laurenzo Specialty Products
candidates.partition_evidence: Division 10 supplier since 1977; toilet partitions page names 9 brands; services page lists 'Installation' as a bullet after the Division 10 list but never ties it to partitions; no partition install projects or photos seen.
red_flags: Sells toilet partitions itself (direct buy-around risk; same brands incl. ASI, Bobrick, Bradley, Scranton, Metpar)
Installation of partitions not explicitly confirmed
candidates.reason: Local commercial Division 10 supplier that lists installation as a service, but no page shows it installing partitions, and it is a direct competitor selling the same brands.

license.name: J. Laurenzo Specialty Products
license.registry: Iowa DIAL Contractor Registration public search (laborportal.iwd.iowa.gov/iwd_portal/publicSearch/public); City of Des Moines has no city general contractor license
license.note: Checked 2026-11-19. Iowa requires DIAL contractor registration for anyone earning $2,000+ a year from construction (DIAL page). The official lookup is a JavaScript app that returns HTTP 404 to automated fetches, so registration could not be read; check it by hand in a browser. Des Moines sets no city general contractor license (per area rule). The company site (https://www.laurenzospecialties.com/) names Urbandale, IA as base city, lists toilet partitions and installation, phone 515-331-3074, and shows no registration number.

red_flags: Primarily a door, frame and hardware distributor; partition installation not shown in projects
candidates.reason: Employee-owned commercial door/hardware firm (Des Moines plus 6 other Iowa offices) that lists toilet partitions and an installation service, but no partition installs are shown.

candidates.reason: Omaha Division 10 supplier with no stated installation and no stated Des Moines service; out of range.
